opening: Actual printed article title, issuer/address and greeting retained as printed.
closing: The printing credits the London Tablet translation. All historical source notes retained separately from the body.
translation_identity: Historical human English as printed in the named contemporary issue; attribution retained where the printing supplies one.
source_notes: Each printed page-foot source note is retained in its original separate blank-line block; numbered internal headings and quotations retain their order.
boundary_exclusions: Earlier and following articles, masthead and running furniture excluded by exact physical-line bounds and full-line exclusions. Native closing continues above the following article even where the running head changes.
wording_limit: All native act pages inspected for continuous full printed extent and boundary fidelity; not a complete word-by-word collation. OCR errors remain.
